# laravelforge_org_server_credential (Resource)

Shares an organization server credential with a team in Laravel Forge. This manages the share linkage only (created on POST, removed on DELETE); the credential object itself is read-only. There is no update — any change recreates the share.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (Number) ID of the server credential to share with the team.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `team_id` (Number) ID of the team the credential is shared with.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_provider` (String) Provider the credential authenticates against, e.g. `Hetzner Cloud` (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `in_use` (Boolean) Whether the credential is currently in use by a server.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
